Iran-US Talks Stall Over Strait of Hormuz Deal

Iran has stated that the United States has accepted some of its demands concerning the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz, but negotiations are stalled. An Iranian official indicated that the US needs to clarify remaining issues that are unclear to Tehran, suggesting Iran is no longer replying to the US regarding a proposal for the Strait of Hormuz. The coverage does not specify the nature of the demands or the exact points of contention.
